listing.name: Yoshi's Cookie NES Recomp
listing.summary: Play Yoshi's Cookie with the official Windows runtime and your matching original NES ROM.

steps.title: Use the official Windows player
steps.instruction: Download the Windows x64 ZIP from Yoshi’s Cookie Recomp Releases. Extract the whole archive, open YoshisCookieRecomp.exe and select your own matching USA ROM before registering the prepared copy in Portcove.

steps.title: Register your prepared Windows copy
steps.instruction: After setup, close the player. In Portcove select YoshisCookieRecomp.exe and its extracted folder. Add the original ROM’s full path as one argument line without quotes. If you leave the argument empty, keep the upstream launcher enabled.

steps.title: Build the Linux player from upstream source
steps.instruction: On Linux x86-64, use the upstream source and its pinned submodules, CMake, a native C/C++ toolchain and system SDL2 development files. Set SDL2_DIR to the system SDL2 CMake package and NESRECOMP_ROM to your matching USA original. Build and launch through the upstream instructions.

steps.title: Keep your settings and saves
steps.instruction: Back up your actual settings and saves with the game closed before updating the player. Keep cycle save states with their creating build. Removing a Portcove registration leaves the player, original and profile in place.

warnings: The existing Portcove registration route is for the Windows package. Linux setup uses the player’s own upstream build.

references.title: Reviewed Windows package and Linux source evidence
references.instruction: See https://github.com/mstan/YoshisCookieRecomp/releases/tag/v1.1.1 for the reviewed Windows ZIP and upstream Linux system SDL2 instructions.

presentation.manual_preparation: Download the official Windows x64 ZIP from upstream Releases and extract the entire archive, including its DLLs and assets. Run YoshisCookieRecomp.exe, use Browse For ROM to select your own matching Yoshi's Cookie (USA) NES ROM, then Play and close normally. Return to Portcove, choose that executable and its extracted folder as the working directory, add the original ROM's full path as one argument, and review the launch details before registering. In Desktop, enter that path on one line without surrounding quotes. This also works when upstream's Skip launcher on boot is enabled; leaving arguments empty requires the launcher to remain enabled. You or upstream handle runtime updates. Remove registration only forgets Portcove's reference; the runtime, original, saves and settings stay in place. Existing Portcove-built installations retain their original contracts.
